sources.title: Local OT AI Software - otbase.com
sources.snippet: OTbase Insight does not rely on a public AI platform like x.AI or Open AI. It runs on a server in your data center or private cloud. Hardware requirements are reasonable because OTbase Insight is optimized for a very narrow domain: Your contextualized OT asset inventory, as represented in OTbase Inventory. Depending on your inventory size, a low-cost consumer-grade gaming server may suffice.
